title: The game table: games with a cousin
kaylee: She taps the table in her room, picks a game and a cousin, and BB, Gan or Ken hops over and plays the Unicorn Dice Game, Candy Land or Chutes and Ladders with her, cheering and groaning along.
questions: Do the cousins sound like they're having fun at the table? (yes / redo)
Ready for Kaylee to play it? (yes / not yet)
